$description: What is machine-ENFORCED versus what is convention. Never let a reader assume a convention is a guarantee.

enforced.rule: Section / template / route / assetRole / motion-pattern ids are closed enums.
The motion object is closed; an invented motion field is rejected.
A PageSpec's nodes are cross-referenced against its DECLARED template's real node list.
Per-field maxWords budgets, resolved through component and primitive $refs.
must-not-fabricate / must-reuse-exact asset roles cannot be marked generate-new.
Allowlist parity: no phantom allowlist entry, no orphaned contract file.
enforced.provenBy: a scratch-copy drift test that injects a phantom entry and confirms failure

enforced.rule: Citation validity: every measuredFrom resolves to a real, in-range span of a real file.
enforced.provenBy: a scratch-copy drift test that injects an out-of-range citation

enforced.rule: registry.manifest.json's counts block is RECOMPUTED from the files it summarises.
enforced.provenBy: a scratch-copy drift test that injects a wrong count

enforced.rule: allowlistVersion in the manifest matches component-allowlist.json's own version.
Every rule id in compatibility/graph.json has a matching implementation in semantic_validate.py, and vice versa.

conventionOnly.status: documentation-only. The schema pins the value with a const, but no process bumps it.
declared in the real Tailwind theme but used by no component. Available, not endorsed.
